text:
Predicates:
Player(x) ::: x is a football player.
Loaned(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
Player(Ailton) ∧ Loaned(Ailton, Braga) ∧ PlaysFor(Ailton, Nautico) ∧ BornIn(Ailton, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(Ailton, Ailton) ∧ Brazilian(Ailton) ∧ Club(Nautico) ∧ Club(Braga) ∧ Club(Fluminense) ::: Ailton Silva is a football player born in 1995, known as Ailton, Brazilian, plays for Nautico, loaned to Braga, and Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬PlaysFor(Ailton, Fluminense) ::: Ailton Silva did not play for Fluminense.
